extraction_notes: Transfer curve digitized from the TA = 25 degC trace in Fig. 5 at VDS = 10 V.
Output curves digitized from Fig. 1 for VGS = 3.0 V, 5.0 V, and 10.0 V; the figure does not state a temperature.
No capacitance-versus-VDS figure is published; capacitances are taken from the tabulated typical values at VDS = 25 V.
No body-diode reverse-recovery trr or Qrr data is published.
omission_reason: No capacitance-versus-VDS curve or body-diode reverse-recovery data is published; capacitance extraction is limited to the tabulated single-bias values and reverse recovery is omitted.
